children: Stock-specific activity is likely to remain in focus on Dalal Street on September 4, following a slew of corporate developments, order win and brokerage calls.

Angel One share price rose 5% after mixed set of business updates for the month of August. Its gross client acquisition rose 19.9% MoM and 3.8% YoY to 0.57 million in August, while its client base increased 1.4% MoM and 17.8% YoY to 39.56 million. However, the number of orders declined 18.7% MoM and 0.3% YoY to 109.50 million, with average daily orders falling 11% MoM and 9.8% YoY to 5.21 million.

Shares of Ramco Systems added more than 2% on signing Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Safran Helicopter Engines, a leading manufacturer of rotorcraft turbines, to collaborate on enabling the seamless integration of Safran’s engine data with Ramco Aviation Software.

Sterlite Technologies share price rose 5% after board approved a capex of Rs 3,000 crore for the company’s existing manufacturing facility, in view of global demand for optical fibre cables and connectivity solutions.

Polycab India shares shed 5% after research house JPMorgan kept an 'overweight' rating on the stock with a target price of ₹10,000, saying UltraTech’s wires and cables launch is sentiment-negative but unlikely to have a meaningful business impact, given only ₹888 crore of capex spent so far versus ₹1,800 crore approved.

It expects the focus on residential wires, which account for around 30% of Polycab/KEI revenue, to limit the medium-term impact, while viewing any meaningful correction towards the 3-year trough valuation of 31-32x as a buying opportunity.
Focus is likely to shift back to strong sector fundamentals once UltraTech’s entry is digested, with pricing and channel margins/incentives offered by UltraTech as key monitorables.

Investors are expected to remain focused on brokerage calls, block deals, order wins, regulatory developments and other company-specific triggers that could drive stock-level volatility during the session.

title: Buzzing Stocks: Polycab falls 5% despite JPMorgan's 'overweight' rating; Angel One rises 5%
